creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Raised 2026-10-13 alongside the fix for a_2hKMo9s9t, which stops a gone participant from making a pane name ambiguous. A live one still can: `pane new --name`, `pane rename`, or a harness /rename the pane follows can give a pane a name a live participant on this machine joined by, because the daemon checks only drawn words against joined names (`session.rs::draw_word`). After that, `msg post --to` the name is refused as ambiguous until one side changes.

Options: refuse `pane new --name` and `pane rename` to a live participant's name, as `join` refuses a pane's name; for a harness rename, keep the pane's old name and log it, as `session.name.held` does for a name another pane holds. Card a_2dog2o3cN is in the same lookup.
title: A pane can be named after a live participant elsewhere, and --to that name is then ambiguous
